### Download

**[Satsuma-Setup.exe](https://github.com/kalharakeh/satsuma/releases/latest/download/Satsuma-Setup.exe)** is the installer. No admin rights needed. It's much smaller now that the AI libraries download on first use.
`Satsuma-portable.zip` is the same app without an installer. Unzip it and run `Satsuma.exe --install` once. `Satsuma-AI-pack.zip` is fetched automatically, so you don't need to download it yourself.

> Windows SmartScreen may warn because the app isn't code-signed yet: click **More info → Run anyway**.

### New in 1.1

- **Fit under X MB:** shrink any image, video, audio file or PDF to a target size (email, Discord, upload forms)
- **Text panel:** while Shift-dragging text, drop it on UPPER / lower / Title / Clean / Translate / QR / Save / Count
- **Send to phone:** drop a file and scan a QR code; it downloads over your Wi-Fi, no cloud
- **Privacy blur:** faces found automatically, plus your own boxes; blur, pixelate or black bar
- **PDF:** reorder / delete / rotate pages, sign (draw your signature once), watermark, tables → Excel
- **Video:** join clips, change speed, GIF from a range, burn in captions, remove background noise, save frames
- **AI upscale 2× / 4×** (Real-ESRGAN, offline)
- **Photos:** sort into folders by date taken, find duplicates
- **Settings window:** presets editor, watch folders, AI pack, and the switches from the tray
- **Automatic updates:** a daily check, and one click to install
- Fixed a rare crash when the drop panel closed

### Already in 1.0

Shift-drag files and text · ~100 conversions · background removal · subtitles from speech · OCR · trim · PDF passwords · batch rename · presets · watch folders · undo
